newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek socialists' lead irreversible, official.
newsitem.headline: Greek socialists' lead irreversible, official.

text.p: Greece's ruling socialists have an "irreversible" lead over the opposition conservatives, based on the first official figures, the interior ministry said.

With results from 707 out of the 17,710 polling stations counted, acting Interior Minister Vassilis Kouris said that the ruling socialists had 42.8 percent of the vote and the opposition conservatives 39.8 percent.
"The socialists are leading by a margin of three percentage points. This difference is not reversible and it will probably widen," Kouris said in a television announcement.
The Coalition of the Left had 4.8 percent, the Communist Party 4.72 percent, the leftist Democratic Social Movement 3.78 percent and the nationalist Political Spring party 3.0 percent, he said.
